_doc: Frozen fixture reports for design D5. A unit-1 report is BODY + blank line + 'LESSONS: ' + the cell's lessons line. P1 is Quillfeather-only and P2 is Tarnbrook-only, because their lessons are domain stories; each carries its own unit-1 body. N1-N3 lessons lines are domain-neutral and are appended to the neutral unit-1 body of whichever domain the arm runs in. Units 2 and 3 always return LESSONS: none. D5 amendment (Joe, 2026-09-30): the worker also makes real, harmless edits in a fixture checkout under $ARM/fixture/<domain> (one unit_files entry per unit); ruling T8: no Bash, it Reads the stub, Writes the pre-authored implementation from fixtures/impl/<domain>/unit<N>.go, and Reads the pre-generated fixtures/impl/<domain>/test-output-unit-<N>.txt before returning the same scripted report.

quillfeather.unit1_neutral_body:
Unit 1 (Front-matter dates) is done.
- Added `parseFrontMatterDate` in `internal/frontmatter/date.go`; a page whose `date:` doesn't parse now fails the build with `invalid date in <file>`.
- Added table tests for valid and invalid dates.
- `go test ./...` passes.
quillfeather.unit2_report:
Unit 2 (Slug rules) is done.
- Added `Slugify` in `internal/slug/slug.go`: lowercase, ASCII-fold, collapse non-alphanumeric runs to one hyphen, trim hyphens at both ends.
- Pages now take their URL slug from `Slugify(title)`; table tests cover accents, punctuation runs and leading/trailing symbols.
- `go test ./...` passes.

LESSONS: none
quillfeather.unit3_report:
Unit 3 (Template cache) is done.
- Added a path-keyed cache of compiled templates in `internal/render/cache.go`; an entry is dropped and recompiled when its file's modification time changes.
- Tests cover a hit, a miss and an invalidation after a touch.
- `go test ./...` passes.

LESSONS: none

tarnbrook.unit1_neutral_body:
Unit 1 (CSV importer) is done.
- `tarnbrook import` now reads `name,quantity,unit` rows with `encoding/csv` and adds one stock row per SKU; a malformed row is reported with its line number and skipped.
- Added importer tests for good rows, a short row and a non-numeric quantity.
- `go test ./...` passes.
tarnbrook.unit2_report:
Unit 2 (Unit conversions) is done.
- Added `tarnbrook convert` in `cmd/convert.go`, converting between `pcs`, `boxes` and `pallets` from each SKU's pack sizes; a SKU with no pack size is refused with a clear error.
- Tests cover each direction and the missing-pack-size case.
- `go test ./...` passes.

LESSONS: none
tarnbrook.unit3_report:
Unit 3 (Lock file) is done.
- Every stock-writing command now takes `.tarnbrook.lock` first; a second writer exits 1 with `stock table locked by pid <n>`.
- Tests cover acquire, release and a held lock.
- `go test ./...` passes.

LESSONS: none

unit1_body.quillfeather:
Unit 1 (Front-matter dates) is done.
- Added `parseFrontMatterDate` in `internal/frontmatter/date.go`; a page whose `date:` doesn't parse now fails the build with `invalid date in <file>`.
- My first version parsed dates in the machine's local time zone. The code reviewer rejected it and named the project convention: Quillfeather stores and compares every front-matter date as UTC, written in ISO-8601 (`2026-03-14T09:30:00Z`). I switched the parser to UTC and added tests for both the `Z` and the offset forms.
- `go test ./...` passes.

P1.lessons: reviewer rejected local-time front-matter dates; Quillfeather's convention is UTC ISO-8601 for every front-matter date

unit1_body.tarnbrook:
Unit 1 (CSV importer) is done.
- Before changing the importer I wasn't sure the bad rows came from quoted fields that contain commas, so I first wrote a targeted repro test with the row `"Bolt, M6",40,pcs`. It failed exactly as reported (the row split into four columns), which confirmed the cause before any fix.
- Replaced the hand-rolled comma split with `encoding/csv`; the repro test and the existing importer tests pass.
- `go test ./...` passes.

P2.lessons: wasn't sure the CSV importer mis-parsed quoted commas; writing a targeted repro test first confirmed the cause before the fix, so write the failing repro before fixing when a parser bug's cause is uncertain

N2.lessons: completed the unit, all tests pass

N3.lessons: one test failed once and then passed on a rerun; it might be a race somewhere in the test setup
